name: Sundown Marsh
summary: In the Wetlands' far west, deep water and stagnant pools make Sundown Marsh dangerous. An eccentric pair keeps a solitary home along its muddy borders.

sections.title: A Wild and Murky Sinkhole
sections.body: Sundown Marsh spreads through the Wetlands' deepest western reaches. Deep water and thick mud conceal giant crocolisks, shifting oozes, roaming raptors, and territorial Mosshide gnolls in the mist. Most travelers stay on the cobblestone road between Menethil Harbor and Ironforge, leaving this corner largely untamed.

sections.title: Life at the Edge of the Mire
sections.body: A lonely stone cottage and churning windmill stand among the marsh's hazards. The gnome Fradd Swiftgear and the dwarf Wenna Silkbeard make their living scavenging the bog. They sell travelers curiosities and rare trade recipes recovered from the mire, though reaching them means braving its aggressive denizens.

faq.answer: Sundown Marsh lies in the Wetlands' deepest western reaches, in the northwest and away from the main royal roads.

The gnome Fradd Swiftgear and the dwarf Wenna Silkbeard live in a small stone dwelling with a windmill. They make their living scavenging the bog and sell oddities and rare goods to passing travelers.

faq.q: What threats can be found in Sundown Marsh?
faq.answer: Giant crocolisks, foul oozes, bog beasts, raptors, and hostile Mosshide gnolls threaten travelers. These dangers discourage casual exploration.

faq.q: Why would an adventurer travel into Sundown Marsh?
aliases: reasons to go to sundown marsh
faq.answer: Travelers visit the windmill cottage to trade with Fradd Swiftgear and Wenna Silkbeard. They offer rare recipes and peculiar curiosities scavenged from the surrounding swamp.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see Fradd Swiftgear and Wenna Silkbeard making a home beside their windmill in dangerous mud. Their ingenuity shows how gnomes can make a comfortable home anywhere.
